sanskrit: ma̱hām̐ a̍sy adhva̱rasya̍ prake̱to na ṛ̱te tvad a̱mṛtā̍ mādayante | ā viśve̍bhiḥ sa̱ratha̍ṁ yāhi de̱vair ny a̍gne̱ hotā̍ pratha̱maḥ sa̍de̱ha ||
english: Great art thou, the presiding spirit of the sacrifice; without thee the immortals do not rejoice. Come hither on the same chariot with all the gods, O Agni; sit here as Hotṛ, foremost of all.

sanskrit: tvām ī̍ḻate aji̱raṁ dū̱tyā̍ya ha̱viṣma̍nta̱ḥ sada̱m in mānu̍ṣāsaḥ | yasya̍ de̱vair āsa̍do ba̱rhir a̱gne 'hā̍ny asmai su̱dinā̍ bhavanti ||
english: Thee, the swift messenger, do the oblation-bearing men always invoke for embassy; he upon whose sacrificial grass thou, O Agni, hast sat down with the gods — for him the days become auspicious.

sanskrit: triś ci̍d a̱ktoḥ pra ci̍kitu̱r vasū̍ni̱ tve a̱ntar dā̱śuṣe̱ martyā̍ya | ma̱nu̱ṣvad a̍gna i̱ha ya̍kṣi de̱vān bhavā̍ no dū̱to a̍bhiśasti̱pāvā̍ ||
english: Thrice in the night do they discern the treasures stored within thee for the mortal worshipper. Like Manu, O Agni, worship the gods here for us; be our messenger and protector against malediction.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ī̍śe bṛha̱to a̍dhva̱rasyā̱gnir viśva̍sya ha̱viṣa̍ḥ kṛ̱tasya̍ | kratu̱ṁ hy a̍sya̱ vasa̍vo ju̱ṣantāthā̍ de̱vā da̍dhire havya̱vāha̍m ||
english: Agni is lord of the great sacrifice; Agni is lord of every oblation that has been made. The Vasus indeed delight in his will; therefore the gods appointed him the bearer of oblations.

sanskrit: āgne̍ vaha havi̱radyā̍ya de̱vān indra̍jyeṣṭhāsa i̱ha mā̍dayantām | i̱maṁ ya̱jñaṁ di̱vi de̱veṣu̍ dhehi yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: O Agni, bring hither the gods to partake of the oblation; let those whose chief is Indra rejoice here. Place this sacrifice among the gods in heaven. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.

sanskrit: aga̍nma ma̱hā nama̍sā̱ yavi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ yo dī̱dāya̱ sami̍ddha̱ḥ sve du̍ro̱ṇe | ci̱trabhā̍nu̱ṁ roda̍sī a̱ntar u̱rvī svā̍hutaṁ vi̱śvata̍ḥ pra̱tyañca̍m ||
english: With great reverence we have come to the youngest, who blazes when kindled in his own dwelling, the brilliantly shining one who fills the two wide worlds, who is well-fed with oblations, turned toward all sides.

sanskrit: sa ma̱hnā viśvā̍ duri̱tāni̍ sā̱hvān a̱gniḥ ṣṭa̍ve̱ dama̱ ā jā̱tave̍dāḥ | sa no̍ rakṣiṣad duri̱tād a̍va̱dyād a̱smān gṛ̍ṇa̱ta u̱ta no̍ ma̱ghona̍ḥ ||
english: He who overpowers all evils by his greatness — Agni, Jātavedas, is praised in the house. May he guard us from sin and reproach, both us who hymn him and our bountiful patrons.

sanskrit: tvaṁ varu̍ṇa u̱ta mi̱tro a̍gne̱ tvāṁ va̍rdhanti ma̱tibhi̱r vasi̍ṣṭhāḥ | tve vasu̍ suṣaṇa̱nāni̍ santu yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Thou art Varuṇa and also Mitra, O Agni; the Vasiṣṭhas strengthen thee with their hymns. May the readily won treasures be in thee. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.

sanskrit: prāgnaye̍ viśva̱śuce̍ dhiya̱ṁdhe̍ 'sura̱ghne manma̍ dhī̱tim bha̍radhvam | bhare̍ ha̱vir na ba̱rhiṣi̍ prīṇā̱no vai̍śvāna̱rāya̱ yata̍ye matī̱nām ||
english: Bring forth the prayer and meditation for Agni, the all-purifying, the thought-sustaining, the slayer of Asuras; being gladdened on the sacrificial grass, like an offering brought, for Vaiśvānara, the marshaller of thoughts.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne śo̱ciṣā̱ śośu̍cāna̱ ā roda̍sī apṛṇā̱ jāya̍mānaḥ | tvaṁ de̱vām̐ a̱bhiśa̍ster amuñco̱ vaiśvā̍nara jātavedo mahi̱tvā ||
english: Thou, O Agni, blazing with thy flame, hast filled both worlds at thy birth. Thou hast freed the gods from malediction, O Vaiśvānara Jātavedas, by thy greatness.

sanskrit: jā̱to yad a̍gne̱ bhuva̍nā̱ vy akhya̍ḥ pa̱śūn na go̱pā irya̱ḥ pari̍jmā | vaiśvā̍nara̱ brahma̍ṇe vinda gā̱tuṁ yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: When, O Agni, thou wast born, thou surveyedst all the worlds, moving freely like a herdsman among cattle, wandering everywhere. O Vaiśvānara, find the path for the brahman. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.

sanskrit: sa̱midhā̍ jā̱tave̍dase de̱vāya̍ de̱vahū̍tibhiḥ | ha̱virbhi̍ḥ śu̱kraśo̍ciṣe nama̱svino̍ va̱yaṁ dā̍śemā̱gnaye̍ ||
english: With fuel, with invocations of the gods, with oblations to Jātavedas the divine, to the bright-flaming one — reverently we would serve Agni with our gifts.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ te̍ agne sa̱midhā̍ vidhema va̱yaṁ dā̍śema suṣṭu̱tī ya̍jatra | va̱yaṁ ghṛ̱tenā̍dhvarasya hotar va̱yaṁ de̍va ha̱viṣā̍ bhadraśoce ||
english: We would tend thee, O Agni, with fuel; we would serve thee with good praise, O adorable one; we, O Hotṛ of the sacrifice, with ghee; we, O god, with oblation, O thou of auspicious flame.

sanskrit: ā no̍ de̱vebhi̱r upa̍ de̱vahū̍ti̱m agne̍ yā̱hi vaṣa̍ṭkṛtiṁ juṣā̱ṇaḥ | tubhya̍ṁ de̱vāya̱ dāśa̍taḥ syāma yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Come to us with the gods at the invocation of the gods, O Agni, delighting in the vaṣaṭ-call. May we be givers to thee, the divine. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.

sanskrit: u̱pa̱sadyā̍ya mī̱ḻhuṣa̍ ā̱sye̍ juhutā ha̱viḥ | yo no̱ nedi̍ṣṭha̱m āpya̍m ||
english: Into the mouth of the bountiful, the approachable one, pour the oblation — he who is to us the nearest helper.

sanskrit: yaḥ pañca̍ carṣa̱ṇīr a̱bhi ni̍ṣa̱sāda̱ dame̍-dame | ka̱vir gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱r yuvā̍ ||
english: He who has sat down over the five tribes in house after house — the wise, the householder, the ever-young.

sanskrit: sa no̱ vedo̍ a̱mātya̍m a̱gnī ra̍kṣatu vi̱śvata̍ḥ | u̱tāsmān pā̱tv aṁha̍saḥ ||
english: May Agni guard our wealth and household folk on every side, and also guard us from distress.

sanskrit: nava̱ṁ nu stoma̍m a̱gnaye̍ di̱vaḥ śye̱nāya̍ jījanam | vasva̍ḥ ku̱vid va̱nāti̍ naḥ ||
english: I have fashioned a new hymn for Agni, the falcon of the sky — will he win treasure for us?

sanskrit: spā̱rhā yasya̱ śriyo̍ dṛ̱śe ra̱yir vī̱rava̍to yathā | agre̍ ya̱jñasya̱ śoca̍taḥ ||
english: His glories are desirable to behold, like wealth with abundance of heroes, as he blazes at the head of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: semāṁ ve̍tu̱ vaṣa̍ṭkṛtim a̱gnir ju̍ṣata no̱ gira̍ḥ | yaji̍ṣṭho havya̱vāha̍naḥ ||
english: May Agni, the most skilled in worship, the bearer of oblations, come to this vaṣaṭ-call and be pleased with our songs.

sanskrit: ni tvā̍ nakṣya viśpate dyu̱manta̍ṁ deva dhīmahi | su̱vīra̍m agna āhuta ||
english: Thee, the lord of the settlement, the brilliant one, O god, we would fix in our hearts; O Agni, thou who art invoked, bringer of good heroes.

sanskrit: kṣapa̍ u̱sraś ca̍ dīdihi sva̱gnaya̱s tvayā̍ va̱yam | su̱vīra̱s tvam a̍sma̱yuḥ ||
english: Shine through the nights and through the days; through thee may we be possessed of good fire. Thou art rich in heroes, thou desirest us.

sanskrit: upa̍ tvā sā̱taye̱ naro̱ viprā̍so yanti dhī̱tibhi̍ḥ | upākṣa̍rā saha̱sriṇī̍ ||
english: To thee do the inspired men come with their prayers, striving for gain — unto thee, the thousand-streamed, moving near.

sanskrit: a̱gnī rakṣā̍ṁsi sedhati śu̱kraśo̍ci̱r ama̍rtyaḥ | śuci̍ḥ pāva̱ka īḍya̍ḥ ||
english: Agni, the bright-flaming, the immortal, drives away the demons; the pure, the purifying one, he is worthy of praise.

sanskrit: sa no̱ rādhā̱ṁsy ā bha̱reśā̍naḥ sahaso yaho | bhaga̍ś ca dātu̱ vārya̍m ||
english: May he, the lord, the offspring of strength, bring us riches; and may Bhaga grant the desirable gift.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne vī̱rava̱d yaśo̍ de̱vaś ca̍ savi̱tā bhaga̍ḥ | diti̍ś ca dāti̱ vārya̍m ||
english: Do thou, O Agni, grant fame with good heroes; and the god Savitṛ, Bhaga, and Diti give what is desirable.

sanskrit: agne̱ rakṣā̍ ṇo̱ aṁha̍sa̱ḥ prati̍ ṣma deva̱ rīṣa̍taḥ | tapi̍ṣṭhair a̱jaro̍ daha ||
english: O Agni, O god, protect us from distress, ward off the one who injures us; burn him, ageless, with thy most scorching flames.

sanskrit: adhā̍ ma̱hī na̱ āya̱sy anā̍dhṛṣṭo̱ nṛpī̍taye | pūr bha̍vā śa̱tabhu̍jiḥ ||
english: Then the great one comes to us, unconquerable, for the protection of men; be thou a fortress with a hundred arms.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na̍ḥ pā̱hy aṁha̍so̱ doṣā̍vastar aghāya̱taḥ | divā̱ nakta̍m adābhya ||
english: Protect us from sin, O thou undeceivable, from him who seeks to harm, at the fall of evening and of morning, by day and by night.

sanskrit: e̱nā vo̍ a̱gniṁ nama̍so̱rjo napā̍ta̱m ā hu̍ve | pri̱yaṁ ceti̍ṣṭham ara̱tiṁ sva̍dhva̱raṁ viśva̍sya dū̱tam a̱mṛta̍m ||
english: With this reverence I call Agni to you, the offspring of strength, the dearest, the most wakeful, the herald of the sacrifice, the messenger of all, the immortal.

sanskrit: sa yo̍jate aru̱ṣā vi̱śvabho̍jasā̱ sa du̍drava̱t svā̍hutaḥ | su̱brahmā̍ ya̱jñaḥ su̱śamī̱ vasū̍nāṁ de̱vaṁ rādho̍ ja̱nānā̍m ||
english: He yokes the red steeds of universal bounty; he runs swiftly when well-fed with oblations. The sacrifice is well-praised and well-laid; the divine bestowal of riches comes to men.

sanskrit: ud a̍sya śo̱cir a̍sthād ā̱juhvā̍nasya mī̱ḻhuṣa̍ḥ | ud dhū̱māso̍ aru̱ṣāso̍ divi̱spṛśa̱ḥ sam a̱gnim i̍ndhate̱ nara̍ḥ ||
english: His flame has risen up as he, the bountiful, is fed with oblations; the red smoke-columns that touch the sky rise up. The men kindle Agni together.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ dū̱taṁ kṛ̍ṇmahe ya̱śasta̍maṁ de̱vām̐ ā vī̱taye̍ vaha | viśvā̍ sūno sahaso marta̱bhoja̍nā̱ rāsva̱ tad yat tvema̍he ||
english: Thee, the most glorious, we make our messenger; bring the gods hither to the feast. O offspring of strength, grant all that mortals enjoy; give us that which we implore of thee.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱s tvaṁ hotā̍ no adhva̱re | tvam potā̍ viśvavāra̱ prace̍tā̱ yakṣi̱ veṣi̍ ca̱ vārya̍m ||
english: Thou, O Agni, art our householder; thou art the Hotṛ at our rite; thou art the Potṛ, O thou who holdest all desirable things, O wise one; worship and seek the desirable.

sanskrit: kṛ̱dhi ratna̱ṁ yaja̍mānāya sukrato̱ tvaṁ hi ra̍tna̱dhā asi̍ | ā na̍ ṛ̱te śi̍śīhi̱ viśva̍m ṛ̱tvija̍ṁ su̱śaṁso̱ yaś ca̱ dakṣa̍te ||
english: Make a jewel for the sacrificer, O thou of good will; for thou art the giver of jewels. Set in order every priest at the rite, O thou of good praise, and him too who is capable.

sanskrit: tve a̍gne svāhuta pri̱yāsa̍ḥ santu sū̱raya̍ḥ | ya̱ntāro̱ ye ma̱ghavā̍no̱ janā̍nām ū̱rvān daya̍nta̱ gonā̍m ||
english: In thee, O Agni, well fed with oblations, may the patrons be dear — the guiders, the bountiful ones among the people, who share out broad pastures and kine.

sanskrit: yeṣā̱m iḻā̍ ghṛ̱taha̍stā duro̱ṇa ām̐ api̍ prā̱tā ni̱ṣīda̍ti | tām̐s trā̍yasva sahasya dru̱ho ni̱do yacchā̍ na̱ḥ śarma̍ dīrgha̱śrut ||
english: Those in whose house Iḍā with ghee-filled hands sits down at dawn — save them, O mighty one, from treachery and reproach; grant us shelter, O thou of far-famed might.

sanskrit: sa ma̱ndrayā̍ ca ji̱hvayā̱ vahni̍r ā̱sā vi̱duṣṭa̍raḥ | agne̍ ra̱yim ma̱ghava̍dbhyo na̱ ā va̍ha ha̱vyadā̍tiṁ ca sūdaya ||
english: He, the carrier with his sweet tongue, the knower, with his mouth — O Agni, bring riches to us through the bountiful patrons, and set in order the gift of oblations.

sanskrit: ye rādhā̍ṁsi̱ dada̱ty aśvyā̍ ma̱ghā kāme̍na̱ śrava̍so ma̱haḥ | tām̐ aṁha̍saḥ pipṛhi pa̱rtṛbhi̱ṣ ṭvaṁ śa̱tam pū̱rbhir ya̍viṣṭhya ||
english: Those who give horse-wealth and great gifts with desire for fame — save them from sin with those who ferry across; be thou a hundred fortresses for them, O most youthful.

sanskrit: de̱vo vo̍ draviṇo̱dāḥ pū̱rṇāṁ vi̍vaṣṭy ā̱sica̍m | ud vā̍ si̱ñcadhva̱m upa̍ vā pṛṇadhva̱m ād id vo̍ de̱va o̍hate ||
english: The god, the giver of wealth, desires a full vessel for you. Either pour it out, or fill it up; then indeed the god will hear you.

sanskrit: taṁ hotā̍ram adhva̱rasya̱ prace̍tasa̱ṁ vahni̍ṁ de̱vā a̍kṛṇvata | dadhā̍ti̱ ratna̍ṁ vidha̱te su̱vīrya̍m a̱gnir janā̍ya dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: Him, the Hotṛ of the rite, the wise one, the carrier — the gods have made him so. Agni places a jewel and heroic wealth for the worshipper, for the man who gives.

sanskrit: agne̱ bhava̍ suṣa̱midhā̱ sami̍ddha u̱ta ba̱rhir u̍rvi̱yā vi stṛ̍ṇītām ||
english: O Agni, be thou well-kindled with good fuel, and let the sacrificial grass be widely strewn.

sanskrit: u̱ta dvāra̍ uśa̱tīr vi śra̍yantām u̱ta de̱vām̐ u̍śa̱ta ā va̍he̱ha ||
english: And let the willing doors open wide, and here bring hither the willing gods.

sanskrit: agne̍ vī̱hi ha̱viṣā̱ yakṣi̍ de̱vān sva̍dhva̱rā kṛ̍ṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
english: O Agni, go forward with the oblation, worship the gods; make the sacrifice proceed well, O Jātavedas.

sanskrit: sva̱dhva̱rā ka̍rati jā̱tave̍dā̱ yakṣa̍d de̱vām̐ a̱mṛtā̍n pi̱praya̍c ca ||
english: Jātavedas will make the sacrifice proceed well; he will worship the immortal gods and gladden them.

sanskrit: vaṁsva̱ viśvā̱ vāryā̍ṇi pracetaḥ sa̱tyā bha̍vantv ā̱śiṣo̍ no a̱dya ||
english: Win all desirable things, O wise one; may our wishes be fulfilled today.

sanskrit: tvām u̱ te da̍dhire havya̱vāha̍ṁ de̱vāso̍ agna ū̱rja ā napā̍tam ||
english: Thee they have appointed as bearer of oblations, O Agni, the gods have set thee, the offspring of strength.

sanskrit: te te̍ de̱vāya̱ dāśa̍taḥ syāma ma̱ho no̱ ratnā̱ vi da̍dha iyā̱naḥ ||
english: May we be givers to thee, the divine; distribute for us great jewels as thou movest.

sanskrit: tve ha̱ yat pi̱tara̍ś cin na indra̱ viśvā̍ vā̱mā ja̍ri̱tāro̱ asa̍nvan | tve gāva̍ḥ su̱dughā̱s tve hy aśvā̱s tvaṁ vasu̍ devaya̱te vani̍ṣṭhaḥ ||
english: In thee, O Indra, even our fathers won all good things for the praisers; in thee are the good milch cows, in thee indeed the horses; thou art the most bountiful with wealth for the godly man.

sanskrit: rāje̍va̱ hi jani̍bhi̱ḥ kṣeṣy e̱vāva̱ dyubhi̍r a̱bhi vi̱duṣ ka̱viḥ san | pi̱śā giro̍ maghava̱n gobhi̱r aśvai̍s tvāya̱taḥ śi̍śīhi rā̱ye a̱smān ||
english: For thou dwellest with thy wives like a king, enlightening the days as a wise seer. Adorn our hymns, O bountiful one, with kine and horses; sharpen us who strive toward thee for riches.

sanskrit: i̱mā u̍ tvā paspṛdhā̱nāso̱ atra̍ ma̱ndrā giro̍ deva̱yantī̱r upa̍ sthuḥ | a̱rvācī̍ te pa̱thyā̍ rā̱ya e̍tu̱ syāma̍ te suma̱tāv i̍ndra̱ śarma̍n ||
english: These joyful, god-seeking songs have come to thee here competing. May the path of thy riches come toward us; may we be in thy good favor, O Indra, in thy shelter.

sanskrit: dhe̱nuṁ na tvā̍ sū̱yava̍se̱ dudu̍kṣa̱nn upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi sasṛje̱ vasi̍ṣṭhaḥ | tvām in me̱ gopa̍ti̱ṁ viśva̍ ā̱hā na̱ indra̍ḥ suma̱tiṁ ga̱ntv accha̍ ||
english: Wishing to milk thee like a cow in good pasture, Vasiṣṭha has sent forth the sacred songs to thee. May Indra, the lord of cattle for me, come to us every day with good favor.

sanskrit: arṇā̍ṁsi cit paprathā̱nā su̱dāsa̱ indro̍ gā̱dhāny a̍kṛṇot supā̱rā | śardha̍ntaṁ śi̱myum u̱catha̍sya̱ navya̱ḥ śāpa̱ṁ sindhū̍nām akṛṇo̱d aśa̍stīḥ ||
english: Indra made the spreading waters fordable and easy to cross for Sudās; the new praiser silenced the raging Śimyu; he made the curses of the rivers into non-curses.

sanskrit: pu̱ro̱ḻā it tu̱rvaśo̱ yakṣu̍r āsīd rā̱ye matsyā̍so̱ niśi̍tā̱ apī̍va | śru̱ṣṭiṁ ca̍kru̱r bhṛga̍vo dru̱hyava̍ś ca̱ sakhā̱ sakhā̍yam atara̱d viṣū̍coḥ ||
english: Turvaśa and Yakṣu were at the fore as defenders; the fish-like ones pressed close for gain; the Bhṛgus and the Druhyus rendered obedience; the friend ferried his friend across the diverging streams.

sanskrit: ā pa̱kthāso̍ bhalā̱naso̍ bhana̱ntāli̍nāso viṣā̱ṇina̍ḥ śi̱vāsa̍ḥ | ā yo 'na̍yat sadha̱mā ārya̍sya ga̱vyā tṛtsu̍bhyo ajagan yu̱dhā nṝn ||
english: The Paktha, Bhalānas, Bhananta, Alina, Viṣāṇin, and Śiva clans came; he who led the Ārya's allies to battle against the Tṛtsus — through fighting he brought men with cattle-wealth.

sanskrit: du̱rā̱dhyo̱3̱̍ adi̍tiṁ sre̱vaya̍nto 'ce̱taso̱ vi ja̍gṛbhre̱ paru̍ṣṇīm | ma̱hnāvi̍vyak pṛthi̱vīm patya̍mānaḥ pa̱śuṣ ka̱vir a̍śaya̱c cāya̍mānaḥ ||
english: The evil-minded, the senseless, dishonouring Aditi, they seized the Paruṣṇī river; he, the lord, shone forth mightily illumining the earth; the wise one like a beast lay in wait, watching.

sanskrit: ī̱yur artha̱ṁ na nya̱rtham paru̍ṣṇīm ā̱śuś ca̱ned a̍bhipi̱tvaṁ ja̍gāma | su̱dāsa̱ indra̍ḥ su̱tukā̍m̐ a̱mitrā̱n ara̍ndhaya̱n mānu̍ṣe̱ vadhri̍vācaḥ ||
english: They went toward the Paruṣṇī but not back from it; even the swift one did not reach the point of encounter. Indra, for Sudās, subdued the hasty foes, those castrated speakers in the human battle.

sanskrit: ī̱yur gāvo̱ na yava̍sā̱d ago̍pā yathākṛ̱tam a̱bhi mi̱traṁ ci̱tāsa̍ḥ | pṛśni̍gāva̱ḥ pṛśni̍nipreṣitāsaḥ śru̱ṣṭiṁ ca̍krur ni̱yuto̱ ranta̍yaś ca ||
english: They went like cattle without a herdsman from the pasture, as the arranged ones toward their friend. The Pṛśnigāvas, sent by Pṛśni, obeyed; the Niyuts and Rantayas gave obedience.

sanskrit: eka̍ṁ ca̱ yo vi̍ṁśa̱tiṁ ca̍ śrava̱syā vai̍ka̱rṇayo̱r janā̱n rājā̱ ny asta̍ḥ | da̱smo na sadma̱n ni śi̍śāti ba̱rhiḥ śūra̱ḥ sarga̍m akṛṇo̱d indra̍ eṣām ||
english: The king cast down one and twenty men of the Vaikarṇa clans for the sake of fame. Like a wise one who sharpens the sacrificial grass at the altar, the heroic Indra let loose an onslaught against them.

sanskrit: adha̍ śru̱taṁ ka̱vaṣa̍ṁ vṛ̱ddham a̱psv anu̍ dru̱hyuṁ ni vṛ̍ṇa̱g vajra̍bāhuḥ ||
english: Then the vajra-armed one, rolling down, struck the famous, mature Kavaṣa in the waters, and also the Druhyu.

sanskrit: vi sa̱dyo viśvā̍ dṛṁhi̱tāny e̍ṣā̱m indra̱ḥ pura̱ḥ saha̍sā sa̱pta da̍rdaḥ | vy āna̍vasya̱ tṛtsa̍ve̱ gaya̍m bhā̱g jeṣma̍ pū̱ruṁ vi̱dathe̍ mṛ̱dhravā̍cam ||
english: Indra straightway burst asunder all their firm strongholds with might, seven cities of them; he distributed the household wealth of Ānavas to the Tṛtsu; we have overcome Pūru of foul speech in the assembly.

sanskrit: ni ga̱vyavo 'na̍vo dru̱hyava̍ś ca ṣa̱ṣṭiḥ śa̱tā su̍ṣupu̱ḥ ṣaṭ sa̱hasrā̍ | ṣa̱ṣṭir vī̱rāso̱ adhi̱ ṣaḍ du̍vo̱yu viśved indra̍sya vī̱ryā̍ kṛ̱tāni̍ ||
english: The Ānavas and Druhyus who fought for cattle — sixty hundreds, six thousands lay slain; sixty heroes over and above six who were eager for conflict — all the heroic deeds of Indra were accomplished.

sanskrit: indre̍ṇai̱te tṛtsa̍vo̱ vevi̍ṣāṇā̱ āpo̱ na sṛ̱ṣṭā a̍dhavanta̱ nīcī̍ḥ | du̱rmi̱trāsa̍ḥ prakala̱vin mimā̍nā ja̱hur viśvā̍ni̱ bhoja̍nā su̱dāse̍ ||
english: Urged on by Indra, the Tṛtsus, eager for battle, flowed downward like released waters; the ill-befriended ones, making a din with their noise, abandoned all their enjoyments for Sudās.

sanskrit: a̱rdhaṁ vī̱rasya̍ śṛta̱pām a̍ni̱ndram parā̱ śardha̍ntaṁ nunude a̱bhi kṣām | indro̍ ma̱nyum ma̍nyu̱myo̍ mimāya bhe̱je pa̱tho va̍rta̱nim patya̍mānaḥ ||
english: He drove away to the earth half of the hero who drank the cooked offering without Indra, who boasted against him; Indra, the wrathful one, measured out wrath against him; as lord he took possession of the road's course.

sanskrit: ā̱dhreṇa̍ ci̱t tad v eka̍ṁ cakāra si̱ṁhya̍ṁ ci̱t petve̍nā jaghāna | ava̍ sra̱ktīr ve̱śyā̍vṛśca̱d indra̱ḥ prāya̍ccha̱d viśvā̱ bhoja̍nā su̱dāse̍ ||
english: Even with a poor instrument he accomplished that one deed; he struck down even the lion-like one with a needle. Indra cut away the corners of the enclosure and gave all enjoyments to Sudās.

sanskrit: śaśva̍nto̱ hi śatra̍vo rāra̱dhuṣ ṭe̍ bhe̱dasya̍ ci̱c chardha̍to vinda̱ randhi̍m | martā̱m̐ ena̍ḥ stuva̱to yaḥ kṛ̱ṇoti̍ ti̱gmaṁ tasmi̱n ni ja̍hi̱ vajra̍m indra ||
english: Thy perpetual enemies have yielded to thee; find subjugation even for the boasting Bheda. Whoever brings guilt upon the mortal who praises thee — smite him with the sharp thunderbolt, O Indra.

sanskrit: āva̱d indra̍ṁ ya̱munā̱ tṛtsa̍vaś ca̱ prātra̍ bhe̱daṁ sa̱rvatā̍tā muṣāyat | a̱jāsa̍ś ca̱ śigra̍vo̱ yakṣavaś ca ba̱liṁ śī̱rṣāṇi̍ jabhru̱r aśvyā̍ni ||
english: The Yamunā and the Tṛtsus aided Indra; with utmost completeness he robbed Bheda of his strength; the Ajas, Śigrus, and Yakṣus brought him tribute, horse-heads.

sanskrit: na ta̍ indra suma̱tayo̱ na rāya̍ḥ sa̱ṁcakṣe̱ pūrvā̍ u̱ṣaso̱ na nūtnā̍ḥ | deva̍kaṁ cin mānyamā̱naṁ ja̍gha̱nthāva̱ tmanā̍ bṛha̱taḥ śamba̍ram bhet ||
english: Thy favors and thy riches, O Indra, neither the former dawns nor the new ones can count. Thou hast struck down even Devaka who thought himself worthy; of thyself thou hast shattered great Śambara.

sanskrit: pra ye gṛ̱hād ama̍madus tvā̱yā pa̍rāśa̱raḥ śa̱tayā̍tu̱r vasi̍ṣṭhaḥ | na te̍ bho̱jasya̍ sa̱khyam mṛ̍ṣa̱ntādhā̍ sū̱ribhya̍ḥ su̱dinā̱ vy u̍cchān ||
english: They who, exhilarated by thee, have rejoiced from the house — Parāśara, Śatayātu, Vasiṣṭha — they do not forget thy bountiful friendship; may auspicious days dawn for the patrons then.

sanskrit: dve naptu̍r de̱vava̍taḥ śa̱te gor dvā rathā̍ va̱dhūma̍ntā su̱dāsa̍ḥ | arha̍nn agne paijava̱nasya̱ dāna̱ṁ hote̍va̱ sadma̱ pary e̍mi̱ rebha̍n ||
english: Two hundred cows belonging to Devavat's grandson, two chariots with their brides from Sudās — worthy of Agni, I walk around the dwelling of Paijavanesya singing like a Hotṛ, praising the gift.

sanskrit: ca̱tvāro̍ mā paijava̱nasya̱ dānā̱ḥ smaddi̍ṣṭayaḥ kṛśa̱nino̍ nire̱ke | ṛ̱jrāso̍ mā pṛthivi̱ṣṭhāḥ su̱dāsa̍s to̱kaṁ to̱kāya̱ śrava̍se vahanti ||
english: Four gifts of Paijavanesya, well-aimed, adorned with gold pendants, stand out clearly; the dun ones with broad backs from Sudās bear me and my offspring to fame in succession.

sanskrit: yasya̱ śravo̱ roda̍sī a̱ntar u̱rvī śī̱rṣṇe-śī̍rṣṇe viba̱bhājā̍ vibha̱ktā | sa̱pted indra̱ṁ na sra̱vato̍ gṛṇanti̱ ni yu̍dhyāma̱dhim a̍śiśād a̱bhīke̍ ||
english: His fame, distributed head by head, fills both wide worlds; seven rivers praise him like flowing streams; in the forefront of battle he has established himself as our champion, fighting there.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ na̍ro marutaḥ saśca̱tānu̱ divo̍dāsa̱ṁ na pi̱tara̍ṁ su̱dāsa̍ḥ | a̱vi̱ṣṭanā̍ paijava̱nasya̱ keta̍ṁ dū̱ṇāśa̍ṁ kṣa̱tram a̱jara̍ṁ duvo̱yu ||
english: Follow this man, O Maruts, as ye followed Divodāsa, the father of Sudās; the heroic purpose of Paijavanesya is an imperishable, ageless lordship hard to assail, one that strives for service.

sanskrit: yas ti̱gmaśṛ̍ṅgo vṛṣa̱bho na bhī̱ma eka̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṭīś cyā̱vaya̍ti̱ pra viśvā̍ḥ | yaḥ śaśva̍to̱ adā̍śuṣo̱ gaya̍sya praya̱ntāsi̱ suṣvi̍tarāya̱ veda̍ḥ ||
english: Who like a terrible bull with sharp horns, alone, shakes forth all the tribes; who art the dispenser of the wealth of the ever-constant non-worshipper toward the good Soma-presser.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha̱ tyad i̍ndra̱ kutsa̍m āva̱ḥ śuśrū̍ṣamāṇas ta̱nvā̍ sama̱rye | dāsa̱ṁ yac chuṣṇa̱ṁ kuya̍va̱ṁ ny a̍smā̱ ara̍ndhaya ārjune̱yāya̱ śikṣa̍n ||
english: Thou, O Indra, didst indeed aid Kutsa in that battle, hearkening with thy whole self; when thou didst subdue for him the Dāsa Śuṣṇa, the evil-harvesting one, bestowing favor on the son of Arjuna.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dhṛ̍ṣṇo dhṛṣa̱tā vī̱taha̍vya̱m prāvo̱ viśvā̍bhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ su̱dāsa̍m | pra pauru̍kutsiṁ tra̱sada̍syum āva̱ḥ kṣetra̍sātā vṛtra̱hatye̍ṣu pū̱rum ||
english: Thou, O bold one, with thy boldness didst aid Vītahavya; thou hast aided Sudās with all thy aids. Thou hast aided Paurukutsa Trasadasyu in the winning of fields and in the slaying of Vṛtra and Pūru.

sanskrit: tvaṁ nṛbhi̍r nṛmaṇo de̱vavī̍tau̱ bhūrī̍ṇi vṛ̱trā ha̍ryaśva haṁsi | tvaṁ ni dasyu̱ṁ cumu̍ri̱ṁ dhuni̱ṁ cāsvā̍payo da̱bhīta̍ye su̱hantu̍ ||
english: With thy men's-minded heroes at the divine feast, O bay-horsed one, thou slayest many Vṛtras; thou hast lulled to sleep the Dasyu, Cumurin and Dhuni, for Dabhīta, striking well.

sanskrit: tava̍ cyau̱tnāni̍ vajrahasta̱ tāni̱ nava̱ yat puro̍ nava̱tiṁ ca̍ sa̱dyaḥ | ni̱veśa̍ne śatata̱māvi̍veṣī̱r aha̍ñ ca vṛ̱traṁ namu̍cim u̱tāha̍n ||
english: These are thy exploits, O holder of the vajra — that thou didst straightway burst asunder nine and ninety fortresses; in the hundredth at their settling thou didst pierce through; thou slewest Vṛtra and thou slewest Namuci.

sanskrit: sanā̱ tā ta̍ indra̱ bhoja̍nāni rā̱taha̍vyāya dā̱śuṣe̍ su̱dāse̍ | vṛṣṇe̍ te̱ harī̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā yunajmi̱ vyantu̱ brahmā̍ṇi puruśāka̱ vāja̍m ||
english: These enjoyments of thine, O Indra, are of old for the sacrificer who gives the oblation, for Sudās. I yoke thy two powerful bay steeds, O virile one; may the sacred songs, O mighty one, gain strength.

sanskrit: mā te̍ a̱syāṁ sa̍hasāva̱n pari̍ṣṭāv a̱ghāya̍ bhūma harivaḥ parā̱dai | trāya̍sva no 'vṛ̱kebhi̱r varū̍thai̱s tava̍ pri̱yāsa̍ḥ sū̱riṣu̍ syāma ||
english: May we not fall into this snare of thine for evil, O mighty, bay-horsed one. Save us with shelters free from wolves; may we be among thy beloved, O patron.

sanskrit: pri̱yāsa̱ it te̍ maghavann a̱bhiṣṭau̱ naro̍ madema śara̱ṇe sakhā̍yaḥ | ni tu̱rvaśa̱ṁ ni yādva̍ṁ śiśīhy atithi̱gvāya̱ śaṁsya̍ṁ kari̱ṣyan ||
english: We, thy beloved men, O bountiful one, would rejoice as friends at the conquest, in thy shelter. Sharpen Turvaśa and Yādva for the one who is going to render the laudable thing for Atithigva.

sanskrit: sa̱dyaś ci̱n nu te ma̍ghavann a̱bhiṣṭau̱ nara̍ḥ śaṁsanty uktha̱śāsa̍ u̱kthā | ye te̱ have̍bhi̱r vi pa̱ṇīm̐r adā̍śann a̱smān vṛ̍ṇīṣva̱ yujyā̍ya̱ tasmai̍ ||
english: Even now forthwith thy men declare praises, O bountiful, with well-ordered recitations; those who have outstripped the miserly Paṇis with their calls — choose us for that partnership.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa stomā̍ na̱rāṁ nṛ̍tama̱ tubhya̍m asma̱drya̍ñco̱ dada̍to ma̱ghāni̍ | teṣā̍m indra vṛtra̱hatye̍ śi̱vo bhū̱ḥ sakhā̍ ca̱ śūro̍ 'vi̱tā ca̍ nṛ̱ṇām ||
english: These praises of men, O best of men, flow toward thee from us, the givers of bounties. O Indra, be gracious to them in the slaying of Vṛtra, be a hero-companion and a protector of men.

sanskrit: nū i̍ndra śūra̱ stava̍māna ū̱tī brahma̍jūtas ta̱nvā̍ vāvṛdhasva | upa̍ no̱ vājā̍n mimī̱hy upa̱ stīn yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Now, O heroic Indra, urged by the sacred word, strengthen thyself with thy whole body as thou art being praised with aid. Measure out prizes for us, measure out strength. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.

sanskrit: u̱gro ja̍jñe vī̱ryā̍ya sva̱dhāvā̱ñ cakri̱r apo̱ naryo̱ yat ka̍ri̱ṣyan | jagmi̱r yuvā̍ nṛ̱ṣada̍na̱m avo̍bhis trā̱tā na̱ indra̱ ena̍so ma̱haś ci̍t ||
english: The self-sustaining one was born mighty for heroic deeds; he who is to work, the manly one, has worked the waters. He has come, the youthful one, to the seat of men with his aids; Indra is our protector even from great sin.

sanskrit: hantā̍ vṛ̱tram indra̱ḥ śūśu̍vāna̱ḥ prāvī̱n nu vī̱ro ja̍ri̱tāra̍m ū̱tī | kartā̍ su̱dāse̱ aha̱ vā u̍ lo̱kaṁ dātā̱ vasu̱ muhu̱r ā dā̱śuṣe̍ bhūt ||
english: Indra, having grown mightily, will slay Vṛtra; the hero has now aided the praiser with his help. He will make a world for Sudās — yea, the giver of goods will be ever bountiful to the worshipper.

sanskrit: yu̱dhmo a̍na̱rvā kha̍ja̱kṛt sa̱madvā̱ śūra̍ḥ satrā̱ṣāḍ ja̱nuṣe̱m aṣā̍ḻhaḥ ||
english: The warrior, unchallenged, maker of confusion, in the fight a hero, conqueror of all, from his birth invincible in this world — Indra spread apart the battle-lines with his own power and slew the whole hostile host.

sanskrit: u̱bhe ci̍d indra̱ roda̍sī mahi̱tvā pa̍prātha̱ tavi̍ṣībhis tuviṣmaḥ | ni vajra̱m indro̱ hari̍vā̱n mimi̍kṣa̱n sam andha̍sā̱ made̍ṣu̱ vā u̍voca ||
english: Both worlds hast thou, O mighty Indra, filled with thy greatness by thy powers. Indra, the bay-horsed one, dripping with the thunderbolt, has spoken forth in his exhilarations amid the Soma drink.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̍ jajāna̱ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṁ raṇā̍ya̱ tam u̍ ci̱n nārī̱ narya̍ṁ sasūva | pra yaḥ se̍nā̱nīr adha̱ nṛbhyo̱ astī̱naḥ satvā̍ ga̱veṣa̍ṇa̱ḥ sa dhṛ̱ṣṇuḥ ||
english: The bull begat the bull for battle; the woman too gave birth to the manly one. He who is the foremost general, then, among men, the warrior seeking cattle, unwearied, that one is bold.

sanskrit: nū ci̱t sa bhre̍ṣate̱ jano̱ na re̍ṣa̱n mano̱ yo a̍sya gho̱ram ā̱vivā̍sāt | ya̱jñair ya indre̱ dadha̍te̱ duvā̍ṁsi̱ kṣaya̱t sa rā̱ya ṛ̍ta̱pā ṛ̍te̱jāḥ ||
english: The man who seeks to please his terrible mind will surely not stumble nor come to harm. He who places services in Indra through sacrifices, the guardian of Ṛta, born of Ṛta, abides in riches.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndra̱ pūrvo̱ apa̍rāya̱ śikṣa̱nn aya̱j jyāyā̱n kanī̍yaso de̱ṣṇam | a̱mṛta̱ it pary ā̍sīta dū̱ram ā ci̍tra̱ citrya̍m bharā ra̱yiṁ na̍ḥ ||
english: When the former Indra bestowing favor on the later one — the greater one sacrificed the gift of the lesser — the immortal would sit far round about. O brilliant one, bring us the brilliant wealth.

sanskrit: yas ta̍ indra pri̱yo jano̱ dadā̍śa̱d asa̍n nire̱ke a̍driva̱ḥ sakhā̍ te | va̱yaṁ te̍ a̱syāṁ su̍ma̱tau cani̍ṣṭhā̱ḥ syāma̱ varū̍the̱ aghna̍to̱ nṛpī̍tau ||
english: That dear man of thine who has given to thee, O Indra of the stone-thunderbolt, who has been thy friend in the fight — may we be those most gladdened by this good favor of thine; may we be in thy protection, the unhurt, at the men's feast.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa stomo̍ acikrada̱d vṛṣā̍ ta u̱ta stā̱mur ma̍ghavann akrapiṣṭa | rā̱yas kāmo̍ jari̱tāra̍ṁ ta̱ āga̱n tvam a̱ṅga śa̍kra̱ vasva̱ ā śa̍ko naḥ ||
english: This hymn of praise has cried aloud for thee, the bull; and the praise-song too, O bountiful, has called to thee. The desire for wealth has come to thy praiser; do thou, O Śakra, verily be able to help us with treasure.

sanskrit: sa na̍ indra̱ tvaya̍tāyā i̱ṣe dhā̱s tmanā̍ ca̱ ye ma̱ghavā̍no ju̱nanti̍ | vasvī̱ ṣu te̍ jari̱tre a̍stu śa̱ktir yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Do thou, O Indra, grant to us the strength of one who strives toward thee, and those too who are bountiful and drive forward. May thy power toward thy praiser be the power of giving wealth. Do ye ever guard us with all blessings.
